prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. One square painterly folklore encyclopedia illustration of Abada, a small donkey-sized Kongo mythical equine in quiet woodland. Full body in clear side three-quarter view. Exactly two crooked horns arranged along the centerline of its forehead, one in front and one behind. Dark short equine mane, donkey ears. Exactly four equine legs. Each foot is a solid rounded single-piece horse hoof with an uninterrupted smooth front; the hooves must not have any vertical cleft or split. Short thin boar-like tail with small coarse bristly tuft; no flowing horse tail. No antlers, no goat body. Realistic coherent anatomy, restrained copper and forest green atmosphere, no text or watermark. This replaces an incorrect image whose hooves were split like a goat's: ensure all visible hooves are distinctly solid horse hooves.
Edit pass: Edit the provided Abada illustration. Change ONLY all four hooves into normal solid unbroken rounded horse hooves. Remove every vertical central groove, split, cleft and double-toe shape from the fronts of the hooves; the whole front of each hoof must be one smooth uninterrupted broad surface, like a real donkey's hoof. Keep its two crooked forehead horns, short boar-like tufted tail, donkey-like body, ears, pose, forest background, lighting, colors, and all other pixels unchanged. This is an equine, so its feet must be equine, never cloven goat or antelope feet. No text.

previous_attempts.visual_review_notes: Second attempt still has split cloven hooves; requires solid single-piece equine hooves.

visual_review_notes: Final edited image: two crooked horns, four solid single-piece equine hooves, short boar-like tufted tail and donkey-sized body.
